<div class="card-body">
'''TIE Fighter''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイ・ファイター（戦闘機）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍の大型艦がいる星系ではコスト－１で配備できる。能力値１の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-304o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ＴＩＥとはツイン・イオン・エンジンの略。Ｌｎ型は最も普及しており速度と機動性に優れる。両翼のソーラー・パネルはジェネレータを補助。サイナー・フリート・システムズ社製。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' TIE Fighter.

'''Card text:''' May deploy at cost −1 to a system where there is an Imperial capital ship. Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' TIE stands for twin ion engine. The Ln model is the most common, with excellent speed and maneuverability. The solar panels on both wings supplement the generator. Built by Sienar Fleet Systems.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[TIE Fighter]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
